Package com.univalle.fpoe.escriturarapida.event

Class GameListenerAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.univalle.fpoe.escriturarapida.event.GameListenerAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameListener
public abstract class GameListenerAdapter extends Object implements GameListener
Adapter class for GameListener.

All the methods are empty, so a subclass only needs to override the events it uses.
